name: New Relic API
tagline: Observability platform API for metrics, logs, APM, and account management
description: New Relic provides REST and GraphQL (NerdGraph) APIs for querying telemetry, managing alerts, entities, and accounts across its observability platform. Developers use user API keys or license keys with HTTPS endpoints for data ingest and query.

auth.details: API key via Api-Key header (NerdGraph/REST) or X-License-Key for ingest; self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 GB/month data ingest, 1 full platform user, unlimited basic users (API quotas not separately itemized)

rate_limits: NerdGraph: 25 concurrent, ~100 rpm complexity limits; REST API v2: 3,000 req/min per account (see docs)

example.request: curl -X POST https://api.newrelic.com/graphql -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" -d '{"query":"{ actor { user { email } } }"}'

use_cases: list and manage New Relic alerts and conditions
